quest.title: A Cliff-Side Hero's Past
quest.description: A Treasure Hoarder at the top of The Chasm claims to be from the Guhua Clan. Is he crazy, or is he just lost? Or is there some other secret that lies behind this situation?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Ah, why do people covet my great Glaze Lily garden all day long? If any thieves dare approach, I shall surely have them taste the might of the Guhua Clan's martial arts!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: What lowly folk are you? Do you not see that these flowers are kept by someone? How dare you pick them so casually!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Cease this at once!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so these flowers are...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Indeed, they were found by my keen and discerning eye, and watched over thusly for three days!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Not planted by you.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: *cough* No indeed, but they are mine now.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Verily did I even swear in my heart that I shall care for these flowers and create a lovely and great Glaze Lily garden, far from the strictures and standards of the norm!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, you're going to make a Glaze Lily garden... with these flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: What of it? Do you think that I am but a rough person bereft of any sense of aesthetics?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Pah! To think that you would judge books by their covers so.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's not that. It's just that you say you want to create a Glaze Lily garden... though these flowers are actually Qingxin.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: ...Hehehehehe, hahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: I get it now, I get it! You're trying to shake my will, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: But alas for you! I am Tang Wuchou, true disciple of the 320th Guhua Clan generation! Did you really think that you could fool me with such shallow trickery?

choices.text: Does the Guhua Clan really have that many generations of pupils...

response.speaker: Tang Wuchou
response.text: How dare you insult the long and venerable history of the Guhua Clan! Have at ye, scoundrels!

choices.text: You say that, when you're dressed like a Treasure Hoarder...

response.speaker: Tang Wuchou
response.text: Hmph, and what are clothes but things we wear? A person should be judged by the quality of their heart.

response.speaker: Tang Wuchou
response.text: I, Tang Wuchou of the Guhua Clan, must today do a great justice in defeating you two flower thieves. Witness now the might of the Guhua Clan!

talks.objective: Defeat Tang Wuchou, self-proclaimed Guhua disciple

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Ow, ow, ow ow ow... I'm sorry, I'm sorryyyy! Stop hitting me, please!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This person's martial skills...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Are a complete wash.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: To think that I, with my many long years of training, would not be your match all the same...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. They say "a fine saddle for a fine horse, a fair sail for a fair boat"... No, wait, that's not it...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: "A fine sword for a fair hero," that's how it went! So yes, please take this Glaze Lily with you, O mighty hero...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Didn't we already say that these are Qingxin?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, yes, Qingxin, Qingxin indeed. It is as you say...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you really from the Guhua Clan? ...Hmm, right, do you know some guy called Xingqiu?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Xingqiu...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: I have never heard this name. What, does this Xingqiu person call himself a Guhua disciple?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Ah, how could such a knave be allowed to sully the Guhua name...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Right, so he isn't from the Guhua Clan. Actually, y'know, isn't he the one sullying the Guhua name around here?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: One moment, please. Do you have any proof of your claim that you're from the Guhua Clan?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Of course I do, yes! Come now, look at this jade pendant I have on me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is a hereditary treasure of the Guhua Clan?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: This jade pendant was sold to me by an old friend when we parted, and that was when I decided in my heart that it should become just such a hereditary treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Since I began wearing this jade pendant, I feel a dull headache every time I practice martial arts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like this jade pendant has some issues...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Bah, nonsense! The first day I wore it, an adeptus came to me in a dream and taught me the secret arts of the Guhua Clan. The adeptus even said that it was fated that the pendant should have come into my possession.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: The pains I feel in my head are merely growing pains, signs that my consciousness is expanding. That's what the novels say, after all! These are the signs that my thoughts and my will are growing stronger. There can be no problems here!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Unless... Ah, right, yes, I get it!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: ...Hehehehehe, hahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: I see now! You want this jade pendant, but are too afraid to ask, yes? Thus, you seek to use this so-called "problem" as an excuse. How very "moral" of you... I mean, how very polite of you!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: But nay, this is the Guhua Clan's great treasure. If you wish to claim it from me, you must...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: ...You must surely exchange it for something of equal value! Yes! Like a gem the size of a pigeon egg, or something! What would I do about my wounded pride as the 320th-generation disciple of the Guhua Clan otherwise?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Looks like it's this weird pendant thing that's made this guy believe that he's a Guhua disciple, {NICKNAME}... and it's driving him kinda nuts, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If he keeps wearing that pendant... and keeps staying this far above ground, something terrible's gonna happen to him for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So he wants us to get him some "gem the size of a pigeon egg," eh? But he doesn't look like he can tell left from right or good from bad right now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So let's try giving him a few Bird Eggs, shall we?

talks.objective: Give the Bird Egg to Tang Wuchou in exchange for the jade pendant

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There you go, we'll trade this for that jade pendant.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is a... gemstone, the size of a bird's egg, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: The size of a bird's egg? Why, I never... I thought that a gem the size of a pigeon's egg was as large as they could get, but a bird's egg...?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Hehehe, a jade pendant for such a large gem. What a deal!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: And this, naturally, is thanks to the magnanimous inclination of us Guhua disciples— I mean, it was on account of your great sincerity! Yes! Your great sincerity, that led us to make this trade.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Tang Wuchou takes the pendant off and passes it to you...

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: As for this jade pendant, you take it. Your destiny is intertwined with that of us of the Guhua Clan, it seems, so do take care of this treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hahaha, where'd that expression of discontent on your face go, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this thing is filled with Geo energy... Isn't this Smaragdus Jadeite?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon remembers Baizhu saying something about it... Not that Paimon remembers it in full, but whatever it was, this stuff isn't all that good for people.

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: That's not possible. My sworn brother bought this for me... How could he seek to harm me?

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: And he has made so many other ornaments from jade to boot...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your friend, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: That's right. We call him Old Chou. He works in the jade industry.

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: He should be near The Chasm. Last I heard, he's still helping to sell ornaments made from jade...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, if that person's still selling ornaments made from Smaragdus Jadeite, there could be a lot of people being put in harm's way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'd better go down there and check!

choices.text: Is he still selling those ornaments?

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: I'm not sure, but I do know that we can find him near The Chasm...

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: Ah, hello there, you two. Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: Are you here to try your hand at digging for treasure, just for a bit of fun?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nope. We've got something else to talk to you about today.

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: Ah, this jade pendant...

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: Yes, I did indeed sell it here. Let me have a more careful look at it... Wait a moment. This texture, this smoothness, this translucence... Isn't this the very one I sold to Tang Wuchou?

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: Aye, indeed, I knew from the start that this one was different from the others.

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: At the time, I had wanted to sell it for a pretty sum, but it caught Tang Wuchou's eye, and so he begged and cajoled me... until I sold it to him on the cheap.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So there's only one that looks like this?

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: I sure wish I could pull a second one out of my hat, that's for sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew! Good thing it was just this one! This material is filled with elemental energy. If someone without a Vision is in contact with it, they will experience changes in personality and start talking nonsense day in and day out...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tang Wuchou currently believes himself to be a great hero of the Guhua Clan, and spends his days behaving all crazy and stuff.

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: What? H—How could this be?

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: ...Actually, now that you mention it, this gem does resemble the fabled "Smaragdus Jadeite" quite a bit. That material was said to cause its wearers some discomfort.

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: I heard the older folks say while Smaragdus Jadeite is very valuable, it is a thing of ominous portents, and that long-term exposure will bring about calamity.

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: ...Oh no. I've doomed Tang, haven't I?

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: *sigh* We were both Treasure Hoarders once. We decided to part ways after making a pretty sum at The Chasm.

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: I do not know where Tang Wuchou went off to, but as for me... I was found by our former companions. They threatened me, and forced me to buy the low-quality jewelry they make here and sell it in Liyue.

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: They call it "helping with sales," but really... are the materials they use the equal of Shenglu Hall? Or their designs a match for Mingxing Jewelry?

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: They're just making me do the dirty work for them.

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: I had to lower the price so much that I was practically losing Mora on sales.

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: I basically used up all the Mora I made in our previous job... But it seems like those fellows have finally woken up to the idea that they might sell the base materials for a better price. They haven't come to look for me at all recently.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Actually, they've all been captured by Millelith who infiltrated their ranks.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell Old Chou about the destruction of the smuggling den...

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: Hah! That was a good catch for sure, that was!

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: They even threatened to report me to the Millelith too, you know! Now look who's going to eat prison food, hmm?

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: ... *sigh* Sorry, I got off topic. I'm very sorry about Tang, but I... I've buried all my valuables in the dirt... You know, to do a little business, earn a little Mora?

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: How about this, then? I'll let you dig for treasure once. You can give whatever you find to Tang Wuchou as compensation.

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: Well, how about it? Wanna know how you can dig for treasure here?

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: Well then, let's begin the round now!

choices.text: Sure, explain the rules to me...

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: Basically, there's treasure under some of these piles of dirt, but there are also some explosives... But don't worry, they're all duds that haven't been used in ages.

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: If you dig up treasure, it's all yours — take it with my compliments. But if you dig up any explosives, you lose! But just this time...

response.speaker: Old Chou
response.text: Never mind. Just dig first and I'll explain further later.

talks.objective: Dig for treasure once to get Old Chou's compensatory gift

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's go back and look for Tang Wuchou...

talks.objective: Tell Tang Wuchou about Old Chou

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: Hey-ho! This gem is as large as a bird's egg, yes, but it is so very light!

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: And when you hold it up against the light, you can see a shadow within! Fascinating, how very fascinating...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's still looking at that egg, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Mr. Guhua Hero!

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: Sorry, what? Ah, yes! That's me, Tang Wuchou, 320th-generation successor to the Guhua Clan! Surely you must have come hence upon hearing of my great deeds...

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: Eh? Oh, it's you two. Right, how about it, then? Did you find Old Chou?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell Tang Wuchou about Smaragdus Jadeite and give him Old Chou's compensatory gift.

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: That's one huge bag... Lemme see what's in it, eh?

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: What in the world is with all these ornaments? ...And they're all so...

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: ...Ugly.

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: What, is Old Chou trying to make a fool of me? Huh?

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: That jade pendant made from Smaragdus Jadeite cost me lots of Mora! And he even kept contact with those sneaky Treasure Hoarders after supposedly washing his hands off the business!

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: ...Ah, this ancient grudge... I might just have to cut him down for it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And you call yourself a hero...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wasn't that jade pendant something you wanted to buy yourself, anyway?

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: ...Hehehehehe, hahahaha!

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: You have a point.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And it's not like he's got anything to do with the Treasure Hoarders anymore. He's opened a store to let people try their hand at digging for treasure.

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: Digging for treasure? ...Pfft, so he's doing that again... He used to pull that trick to get Mora for wine.

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: Let me tell you something... That treasure hunt of his works like this: the <color=#00E1FFFF>better the goods, the more explosive barrels there will be around it, and vice versa.</color>

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: For example, tiles that turn out to be empty won't have a single explosive barrel near it, while the best stuff is probably surrounded on all four sides by such barrels.

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: Stingy fellow. He's deathly afraid that someone will get their hands on the good stuff, so he set the rules up such that the game ends once you dig up one explosive barrel.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, but he said that he'd just let us keep going this time even if we dug them up...

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: Is... is that so? Well... I suppose there's some goodness left in his heart yet.

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: *sigh* Fair enough. And if I had been there with him back then, my martial prowess would have prevented him from being manipulated by those Treasure Hoarders the way he was...

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: *cough* I mean, come on, I am a martial artist. There might still be some distance between me and a true hero, but I can still handle a few Treasure Hoarders, no problem!

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: I'll go look for him later with two jugs of wine next time, I suppose, and we'll have a chat then.

choices.text: Let's start from the top, shall we...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Well? Like I said, if you can offer an item of equal value, I can give this to you, no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Well, let's try giving him a Bird Egg...)

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: As for this jade pendant, you take it. Your destiny is intertwined with that of us of the Guhua Clan, it seems, so do take care of this treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hahaha, where'd that expression of discontent on your face go, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this thing is filled with Geo energy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Most normal people don't come into contact with elemental energy in their daily lives. There's bound to be trouble if they stay beside such a huge concentration of energy all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: That's not possible. My sworn brother bought this for me... How could he seek to harm me?

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: And he has made so many other ornaments from jade to boot...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your friend, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: That's right. We call him Old Chou. He works in the jade industry.

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: He should be near The Chasm. Last I heard, he's also helping to sell ornaments made from jade...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, if that person's still selling jade ornaments of this sort, there could be a lot of people being put in harm's way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'd better go down there and check!

choices.text: Is he still selling those ornaments?

response.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
response.text: I'm not sure, but I do know that we can find him near The Chasm...

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: Well, let's have a look. What did you get?

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: Oh, so you actually got this bag, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's inside...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh. Uh, these ornaments are kinda...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Ghastly.

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: Well, they were made by the Treasure Hoarders, and proved just about as popular as their makers.

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: But if nothing else, they're still made of genuine materials, so you can still cut those gems out and sell them for a pretty sum... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: Just give this to Tang, will you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, we're off, then!

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: Aye. If you have the time, come around and dig for some more treasure, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Should we go back now, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's pass it to him later...

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: Ah, who'd have thought, who'd have thought? That the world might play host to a gem the size of a bird's egg?

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: Well, how about a round of treasure-hunting, right now? Whatever you dig up will go to Tang Wuchou as compensation.
